status: validated (機械検証合格 2026-11-05; パイロット承認済みの方針で作成)

segments.t: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ,
segments.note: 「Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ」Πέτρος ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

segments.t: to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners
segments.note: 「to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners」ἐκλεκτοῖς παρεπιδήμοις

segments.t: in the Dispersion
segments.note: 「in the Dispersion」διασπορᾶς

segments.t: in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
according to the foreknowledge of God the Father,
segments.note: 「according to the foreknowledge of God the Father」κατὰ πρόγνωσιν θεοῦ πατρός

segments.t: in sanctification of the Spirit,
segments.note: 「in sanctification of the Spirit」ἐν ἁγιασμῷ πνεύματος

segments.t: that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood:
segments.note: 「that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood」εἰς ὑπακοὴν καὶ ῥαντισμὸν αἵματος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ。WEB は名詞句を動詞句にほぐす

segments.t: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
segments.note: 「Grace to you and peace be multiplied」χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη

segments.t: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
segments.note: 「Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ」Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

segments.t: who according to his great mercy
segments.note: 「who according to his great mercy」ὁ κατὰ τὸ πολὺ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος

segments.t: caused us to be born again
segments.note: 「caused us to be born again」ἀναγεννήσας ἡμᾶς。WEB は「caused us to be born again」とほぐす

segments.t: to a living hope
segments.note: 「to a living hope」εἰς ἐλπίδα ζῶσαν

segments.t: through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
segments.note: 「through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead」δι’ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐκ νεκρῶν

segments.t: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away,
segments.note: 「to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away」εἰς ἄφθαρτον καὶ ἀμίαντον καὶ ἀμάραντον κληρονομίαν。WEB は名詞を形容詞の後ろに置く

segments.t: reserved in Heaven for you,
segments.note: 「reserved in Heaven for you」τετηρημένην ἐν οὐρανοῖς εἰς ὑμᾶς

segments.t: who by the power of God are guarded
segments.note: 「who by the power of God are guarded」τοὺς ἐν δυνάμει θεοῦ φρουρουμένους

segments.t: through faith
for a salvation ready to be revealed
segments.note: 「for a salvation ready to be revealed」εἰς σωτηρίαν ἑτοίμην ἀποκαλυφθῆναι

segments.t: in the last time.
In this you greatly rejoice,
segments.note: 「In this you greatly rejoice」ἐν ᾧ ἀγαλλιᾶσθε

segments.t: though now for a little while, if need be,
segments.note: 「though now for a little while, if need be」ὀλίγον ἄρτι εἰ δέον。WEB は「though」を補う

segments.t: you have been grieved in various trials,
segments.note: 「you have been grieved in various trials」λυπηθέντες ἐν ποικίλοις πειρασμοῖς

segments.t: that the proof of your faith,
segments.note: 「that the proof of your faith」ἵνα τὸ δοκίμιον ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως

segments.t: which is more precious than gold that perishes,
segments.note: 「which is more precious than gold that perishes」πολυτιμότερον χρυσίου τοῦ ἀπολλυμένου

segments.t: even though it is tested by fire,
segments.note: 「even though it is tested by fire」διὰ πυρὸς δὲ δοκιμαζομένου

segments.t: may be found to result in
segments.note: 「may be found to result in」εὑρεθῇ εἰς。「to result」は英語の補い

segments.t: praise, glory, and honor
segments.note: 「praise, glory, and honor」ἔπαινον καὶ δόξαν καὶ τιμήν

segments.t: at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
segments.note: 「at the revelation of Jesus Christ」ἐν ἀποκαλύψει Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ

segments.t: whom, not having known, you love.
segments.note: 「whom, not having known, you love」ὃν οὐκ ἰδόντες ἀγαπᾶτε。WEB の「known」はビザンティン本文 εἰδότες に対応する。ギリシャ語本文は ἰδόντες（見て）

segments.t: In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing,
segments.note: 「In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing」εἰς ὃν ἄρτι μὴ ὁρῶντες πιστεύοντες δὲ

segments.t: you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,
segments.note: 「you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory」ἀγαλλιᾶσθε χαρᾷ ἀνεκλαλήτῳ καὶ δεδοξασμένῃ。「full of glory」は δεδοξασμένῃ の表現

segments.t: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
segments.note: 「receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls」κομιζόμενοι τὸ τέλος τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν σωτηρίαν ψυχῶν

segments.t: Concerning this salvation,
segments.note: 「Concerning this salvation」Περὶ ἧς σωτηρίας

segments.t: the prophets sought and searched diligently.
segments.note: 「the prophets sought and searched diligently」προφῆται ἐξεζήτησαν καὶ ἐξηραύνησαν

segments.t: They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
segments.note: 「They prophesied of the grace that would come to you」οἱ περὶ τῆς εἰς ὑμᾶς χάριτος προφητεύσαντες

segments.t: searching for who or what kind of time
segments.note: 「searching for who or what kind of time」ἐραυνῶντες εἰς τίνα ἢ ποῖον καιρόν

segments.t: the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to
segments.note: 「the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to」ἐδήλου τὸ ἐν αὐτοῖς πνεῦμα Χριστοῦ

segments.t: when he predicted the sufferings of Christ
segments.note: 「when he predicted the sufferings of Christ」προμαρτυρόμενον τὰ εἰς Χριστὸν παθήματα。「when he predicted」は英語のほぐし

segments.t: and the glories that would follow them.
segments.note: 「and the glories that would follow them」καὶ τὰς μετὰ ταῦτα δόξας

segments.t: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you,
segments.note: 「To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you」οἷς ἀπεκαλύφθη ὅτι οὐχ ἑαυτοῖς ὑμῖν δὲ διηκόνουν

segments.t: in these things,
segments.note: 「in these things」αὐτά

segments.t: which now have been announced to you
segments.note: 「which now have been announced to you」ἃ νῦν ἀνηγγέλη ὑμῖν

segments.t: through those who preached the Good News to you
segments.note: 「through those who preached the Good News to you」διὰ τῶν εὐαγγελισαμένων ὑμᾶς。「the Good News」は英語の補い（ギリシャ語は εὐαγγελισαμένων の内部）

segments.t: by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven;
segments.note: 「by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven」πνεύματι ἁγίῳ ἀποσταλέντι ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ

segments.t: which things angels desire to look into.
segments.note: 「which things angels desire to look into」εἰς ἃ ἐπιθυμοῦσιν ἄγγελοι παρακύψαι

segments.t: Therefore prepare your minds for action.
segments.note: 「Therefore prepare your minds for action」Διὸ ἀναζωσάμενοι τὰς ὀσφύας τῆς διανοίας ὑμῶν。WEB は慣用句をほぐす

segments.t: Be sober,
segments.note: 「Be sober」νήφοντες

segments.t: and set your hope fully
segments.note: 「and set your hope fully」ἐλπίσατε τελείως。「set your hope」は英語のほぐし

segments.t: on the grace that will be brought to you
segments.note: 「on the grace that will be brought to you」ἐπὶ τὴν φερομένην ὑμῖν χάριν

segments.t: at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
as children of obedience,
segments.note: 「as children of obedience」ὡς τέκνα ὑπακοῆς

segments.t: not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
segments.note: 「not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance」μὴ συσχηματιζόμενοι ταῖς πρότερον ἐν τῇ ἀγνοίᾳ ὑμῶν ἐπιθυμίαις。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: but just as he who called you is holy,
segments.note: 「but just as he who called you is holy」ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸν καλέσαντα ὑμᾶς ἅγιον。「is holy」は ἅγιον から

segments.t: you yourselves also be holy
segments.note: 「you yourselves also be holy」καὶ αὐτοὶ ἅγιοι γενήθητε

segments.t: in all of your behavior,
because it is written,
segments.note: 「because it is written」διότι γέγραπται ὅτι

segments.t: “You shall be holy,
segments.note: 「You shall be holy」Ἅγιοι ἔσεσθε

segments.t: for I am holy.”
segments.note: 「for I am holy」ὅτι ἐγὼ ἅγιος

segments.t: If you call on him as Father,
segments.note: 「If you call on him as Father」Καὶ εἰ πατέρα ἐπικαλεῖσθε

segments.t: who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work,
segments.note: 「who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work」τὸν ἀπροσωπολήμπτως κρίνοντα κατὰ τὸ ἑκάστου ἔργον

segments.t: pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,
segments.note: 「pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear」ἐν φόβῳ τὸν τῆς παροικίας ὑμῶν χρόνον ἀναστράφητε。「living as foreigners here」は παροικίας の表現

segments.t: knowing that you were redeemed,
segments.note: 「knowing that you were redeemed」εἰδότες ὅτι ἐλυτρώθητε

segments.t: not with corruptible things like silver or gold,
segments.note: 「not with corruptible things like silver or gold」οὐ φθαρτοῖς ἀργυρίῳ ἢ χρυσίῳ。「things」は英語の補い

segments.t: from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
segments.note: 「from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers」ἐκ τῆς ματαίας ὑμῶν ἀναστροφῆς πατροπαραδότου

segments.t: but with precious blood,
segments.note: 「but with precious blood」ἀλλὰ τιμίῳ αἵματι

segments.t: as of a lamb without blemish or spot,
segments.note: 「as of a lamb without blemish or spot」ὡς ἀμνοῦ ἀμώμου καὶ ἀσπίλου

segments.t: the blood of Christ,
segments.note: 「the blood of Christ」Χριστοῦ。WEB は「the blood」を繰り返す

segments.t: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world,
segments.note: 「who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world」προεγνωσμένου μὲν πρὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου。「who」は英語の補い

segments.t: but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
segments.note: 「but was revealed in this last age for your sake」φανερωθέντος δὲ ἐπ’ ἐσχάτου τῶν χρόνων δι’ ὑμᾶς

segments.t: who through him are believers in God,
segments.note: 「who through him are believers in God」τοὺς δι’ αὐτοῦ πιστοὺς εἰς θεόν

segments.t: who raised him from the dead and gave him glory,
segments.note: 「who raised him from the dead and gave him glory」τὸν ἐγείραντα αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν καὶ δόξαν αὐτῷ δόντα

segments.t: so that your faith and hope might be in God.
segments.note: 「so that your faith and hope might be in God」ὥστε τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν καὶ ἐλπίδα εἶναι εἰς θεόν

segments.t: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth
segments.note: 「Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth」Τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν ἡγνικότες ἐν τῇ ὑπακοῇ τῆς ἀληθείας

segments.t: through the Spirit
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「through the Spirit」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: in sincere brotherly affection,
segments.note: 「in sincere brotherly affection」εἰς φιλαδελφίαν ἀνυπόκριτον

segments.t: love one another from the heart fervently,
segments.note: 「love one another from the heart fervently」ἀγαπήσατε ἐκ καρδίας ἀλλήλους ἐκτενῶς。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: having been born again, not of corruptible seed,
segments.note: 「having been born again, not of corruptible seed」ἀναγεγεννημένοι οὐκ ἐκ σπορᾶς φθαρτῆς

segments.t: but of incorruptible,
segments.note: 「but of incorruptible」ἀλλὰ ἀφθάρτου

segments.t: through the word of God,
segments.note: 「through the word of God」διὰ λόγου θεοῦ

segments.t: which lives and remains forever.
segments.note: 「which lives and remains forever」ζῶντος καὶ μένοντος。「forever」は英語の補い

segments.t: For, “All flesh is like grass,
segments.note: 「For, “All flesh is like grass」διότι πᾶσα σὰρξ ὡς χόρτος。「is」は英語の補い

segments.t: and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass.
segments.note: 「and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass」καὶ πᾶσα δόξα αὐτῆς ὡς ἄνθος χόρτου。WEB の「man’s」は αὐτῆς（肉の）の意訳

segments.t: The grass withers,
segments.note: 「The grass withers」ὁ χόρτος ἐξηράνθη。WEB の語順はほぐし

segments.t: and its flower falls;
segments.note: 「and its flower falls」καὶ τὸ ἄνθος ἐξέπεσεν。「its」は英語の補い

segments.t: but the Lord’s word endures forever.”
segments.note: 「but the Lord’s word endures forever」δὲ τὸ ῥῆμα κυρίου μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

segments.t: This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
segments.note: 「This is the word of Good News which was preached to you」τοῦτο δέ ἐστιν τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν εἰς ὑμᾶς
